items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 15 at 2:17PM PDT until September 16 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Westerly winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 25 kt.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...From 3 PM to 9 PM PDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
